title: Make every exposed journey reachable from the Station Master through JourneyRunner

facts.note: Journey documents are found by path; entrypoint.exposed is read from their content.
Presence of the Bun Station Master composition root (server.ts holding JOURNEY_MAP).

values: journey entrypoint.exposed or entrypoint actions edited
JOURNEY_MAP or JourneyRunner reference in server.ts edited
facts.note: Discovery hint only, not an enforcement prerequisite: the invariant holds whenever an exposed journey and a Station Master exist, including pre-existing violations. Needs a YAML-aware diff observer and a server.ts JOURNEY_MAP parser.
Validator finding: an exposed journey action is unmapped/mis-mapped, or server.ts does not reference JourneyRunner.

fires: An exposed journey (entrypoint.exposed=true) has an entrypoint action with no JOURNEY_MAP entry in server.ts, whether or not the current task edited it.
A JOURNEY_MAP entry for an exposed journey action points to a different journeyId or path than the declaring journey document.
An exposed journey exists and server.ts does not reference JourneyRunner, even if JOURNEY_MAP has no journey mappings yet.
A change touching only direct-train or direct-interlocking mappings while an exposed journey is already unmapped.
doesNotFire: The journey document declares entrypoint.exposed=false (internal journey).
The repository is in the PLAN stage and has no Station Master composition root yet.

given: a journey document under plan/_journeys/ declares entrypoint.exposed=true and a Bun Station Master composition root (server.ts) exists
when: the repository is in that state (standing invariant; pre-existing violations count, edits are not required)
then: every declared entrypoint action of that journey MUST be reachable from the Station Master via a JOURNEY_MAP entry { journeyId, path: "plan/_journeys/<id>.yaml" } pointing to that same journey document.
prefer: Dispatch journey routes through JourneyRunner (server.ts MUST reference it): Station Master -> JourneyRunner(journeyPath) -> InterlockingRunner -> TrainRunner.
Keep journey routes additive to action -> "train:<subject>:<slug>" and action -> { interlockingId, path }.
avoid: Restating continuation edges in JOURNEY_MAP; it only establishes external reachability, the journey document is authoritative for continuation topology.
Weakening existing direct-train or direct-interlocking mappings.
Mapping to a journeyId/path other than the declaring document, or bypassing JourneyRunner.
unless: entrypoint.exposed=false: internal journeys are intentionally not Station-Master-reachable.
No Station Master composition root yet (PLAN stage), as for exposed interlockings.
why: An exposed journey is executable only if the public entry reaches it via JourneyRunner; this closes the public entry direction of the journey topology.
evidence: The validator reads plan/_journeys/**/*.yaml, selects exposed journeys, and reports no unmapped action: each declared action maps to the same journey_id/path in JOURNEY_MAP.
JOURNEY_MAP journey values do not restate continuation edges, and existing direct-train/direct-interlocking mappings are not weakened.
verifier_detail: Scan plan/_journeys/**/*.yaml; select documents with entrypoint.exposed=true; skip entrypoint.exposed=false.

For each declared entrypoint action require a JOURNEY_MAP key in server.ts whose value is an object { journeyId, path } with journeyId equal to the document's journey_id and path equal to the canonical plan/_journeys/<id>.yaml path.
Require server.ts to reference JourneyRunner whenever an exposed journey exists, independent of whether any journey mappings exist.
Recognise the three additive route forms: string "train:<subject>:<slug>", { interlockingId, path }, { journeyId, path }; only the journey form is checked here.
Emit no finding when the repository has no Station Master composition root (PLAN stage).
Term journey_reachability: the declaration-to-composition-root binding that makes an exposed journey executable.
Term journey_mapping: a Station Master JOURNEY_MAP value carrying journeyId and the canonical journey YAML path.
Check whole-repo state, not only diffs: pre-existing violations are findings.
audit: Original name: Station Master reaches exposed journey topology through JourneyRunner (Bun)

splitSuggestion.then: When an exposed journey exists, the Station Master composition root MUST reference JourneyRunner and dispatch journey routes through it.

sharedNodes.text: Disposition strict: the rule fails on every finding.

additions.text: The JourneyRunner reference/dispatch requirement is independently checkable; proposed as coder.bun.station-master-references-journey-runner. Kept here in prefer[0], avoid[2], evidence[1] and verifier_detail[2] so nothing is lost.
additions.justification: One obligation in then (action reachability via JOURNEY_MAP) while preserving the source's second MUST.

additions.text: verifier_detail[8]: check whole-repo state, pre-existing violations are findings.
additions.justification: Makes explicit that the source statement is a standing invariant ("Every ... MUST be reachable"), not an edit-triggered rule; no new obligation.
